name: Admin Mini-CRM Clients
description: View client list with search, client-status filtering (Todos/Activos/Huérfanos/Inactivos — a transversal selector next to the search box since the filters were reorganised by business module, no longer the top tab row), expand client to see linked proposals, and empty state. The global panel refresh button invalidates the per-client detail cache and refetches expanded rows so renamed/reassigned proposals appear.
